intent: Agent-native Obsidian knowledge vaults with research-backed quality enforcement
vision: Cognitive-science-grounded substrate for personal knowledge bases; closing the gap to an end-to-end LLM knowledge OS (raw → wiki → Q&A → multi-format output → fileback).

features.name: verify-sh-green
verification: ./verify.sh exits 0
all shellcheck checks clean
all frontmatter checks clean
no dangling CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT refs
hooks/hooks.json valid JSON

features.name: hooks-shellcheck-clean
verification: shellcheck zero errors on all hooks/scripts/*.sh
no SC2086 quoting bugs
no SC2155 assignment masking

features.name: frontmatter-lint-clean
verification: all commands/*.md have required YAML keys
all skills/SKILL.md have required keys
all agents/*.md have required keys
no malformed frontmatter blocks

features.name: wiki-search-cli
verification: bin/vault-search script exists and is executable
accepts <vault-root> and <query> args
searches notes/ (compiled surface), NOT ops/raw/
returns plain-text path:line:content hits, paths relative to vault
exit 0 on hits, 1 on miss (fail loud stderr), 2 on misuse/empty vault
tests/test_search_slice.sh enforces anti-cheat: compile → delete raw → hits must come from compiled notes only
documented in README (deferred: slice 2 ships CLI + test; README sweep is a follow-on)
JSON / ranking / semantic search EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE for this slice
--context N flag emits ±N surrounding lines around each hit (grep -C), preserving backward compatibility when omitted; non-numeric arg exits 2

features.name: ask-the-wiki-prototype
verification: commands/query.md exists with valid frontmatter
prompt reads vault MOCs and top-level summaries
returns structured answer with source citations
different from commands/ask.md which queries methodology research

features.name: pdf-ingest-markitdown
verification: bin/vault-ingest-pdf <pdf> <vault-root> exists and is executable
uses Microsoft MarkItDown exclusively (https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown) — no pdftotext/ocrmypdf/pdfminer fallback
markitdown discovery order: $VAULT_TEC_MARKITDOWN, then PATH, then auto-bootstrapped venv at .score/state/mitd-venv/
converts PDF → markdown, then hands off to bin/vault-refile-append with env-attested provenance (REFILED_ORIGINAL_PATH, REFILED_ORIGINAL_SHA256, REFILED_ORIGINAL_FORMAT=pdf)
landed ops/raw/<stem>.md frontmatter: source=<abs pdf path>, original_sha256=<sha of PDF bytes, pre-conversion>, original_format=pdf
SHA-idempotent on PDF bytes: re-run exits 0 with duplicate no-op, no new raw file
propagates through F12: compiled notes carry PDF's original_sha256, so grep across notes/ locates all concepts derived from a given PDF
refuses non-.pdf sources (exit 1); misuse exits 2; missing source exits 1 fail-loud
tests/test_pdf_ingest_slice.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #12
tests/fixtures/sample.pdf is the hermetic fixture for this witness

features.name: raw-compile-command
verification: commands/compile.md exists
reads ops/raw/ or raw/ dir
produces atomic notes tagged status:seed
builds topic MOC
connection weaving ≥2 links/note (requires agent-driven /compile, NOT deterministic replay; P4 forbids fabricating sibling links without semantic grounding)
reports orphan count

features.name: copilot-cli-parity
verification: copilot-extension/extension.mjs exists and parses as ESM (node --check)
copilot-extension/scripts symlinks to hooks/scripts/
all 7 vault-tec hooks are wired via the adapter (6 direct + 1 emulated)
vault_tec_preserve_state tool registered as onPreCompact emulation
JS pre-filter gates bash subprocess spawns to writer tools on vault notes
/vault-tec:setup has Copilot install phase (step 2b)
extension loads via extensions_manage inspect (status: running)

features.name: compile-slice-deterministic-witness
verification: commands/compile.md exists with valid frontmatter and contract text
bin/vault-compile-replay exists and is executable
ops/raw/ exists as ingress directory
tests/test_compile_slice.sh exits 0 against a fresh temp vault
produced notes carry 'status: seed' frontmatter
a *MOC*.md is produced with [[wiki-links]] to all seeds
ops/reports/compile-report.md is emitted with 'orphan_count=N' line
verify.sh includes this as a gating check (8/8)

features.name: render-slice-deterministic-witness
verification: bin/vault-render <vault> <slug> exists and is executable
reads only notes/<slug>.md (compiled truth), never ops/raw/
writes ops/out/<slug>.rendered.md (derived-only; never canonical)
strips YAML frontmatter, rewrites [[wikilinks]] → [name](./name.md), prepends '## Table of Contents'
byte-identical on rerun (determinism)
exit 1 (fail-loud stderr) when source note missing; exit 2 on misuse
tests/test_render_slice.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #9
ops/out/ is derivative — NOT indexed by bin/vault-search, NOT re-ingested by compile

features.name: refile-slice-deterministic-witness
verification: bin/vault-refile-append <source-md> <vault-root> exists and is executable
deposits source into ops/raw/ with provenance frontmatter (source, refiled_at, refiled_by, original_sha256)
original_sha256 is computed from ORIGINAL source bytes (pre-injection)
refiled_by reads $REFILED_BY env (fallback 'unknown')
atomic write via tmpfile+mv; no .tmp stragglers
SHA-idempotent: rerun on identical source exits 0 and creates no new raw file
hard-refuses sources under $VAULT/ops/out/ (no self-fueling render→raw loop); exit 1, fail-loud stderr
does NOT write to notes/ (compile remains bin/vault-compile-replay's job)
emits ops/reports/refile-report.md append-only table with each landing
exit 1 (fail-loud) on missing source; exit 2 on misuse/bad vault root
tests/test_refile_slice.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #10
provenance lives in raw artifact + refile-report — and propagates into notes/ via F12

features.name: provenance-propagation-witness
verification: bin/vault-compile-replay reads original_sha256 from raw/*.md frontmatter
every compiled note (seed + MOC) derived from a provenance-bearing raw carries refiled_from: <rel-raw-path> and original_sha256: <sha> frontmatter keys
honest-contract guard: raws without provenance frontmatter produce notes with NO injected refiled_from/original_sha256 (compiler must never manufacture lineage)
idempotent across repeated compile invocations
tests/test_provenance_propagation.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #11
closes the F11-flagged gap: lineage is now reasonable from notes/ alone, not only from ops/raw/

features.name: e2e-loop-closure-witness
verification: tests/test_e2e_loop.sh exists and is executable
chains refile → compile → search → render in one scenario using a single seed source
asserts refile lands exactly-or-at-least one file in ops/raw/ with original_sha256 frontmatter
asserts compile emits notes/*.md including at least one *-MOC.md
asserts vault-search hits on a unique seeded token appear in notes/-backed output
asserts search output does NOT leak ops/raw/ or ops/out/ paths (compiled-only contract)
asserts vault-render produces ops/out/*.rendered.md and never leaks rendered artifacts into notes/
wired as verify.sh gate #13; makes 12/12 gating checks the new green bar

features.name: vault-detection-agents-md
verification: hooks/scripts/vault-session-start.sh, vault-session-end.sh, vault-precompact.sh accept AGENTS.md as a vault marker (not only CLAUDE.md)
guard still requires self/ and notes/ to be present
bare directory without any marker still short-circuits the hook
tests/test_vault_detection.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #14
unblocks ~/Mind (AGENTS.md vault) from transparently participating in vault-tec hooks

features.name: inbox-drain-option-b
verification: bin/vault-inbox-drain <vault> [--compile] exists, executable
dispatches md/pdf/txt/html from ops/inbox/ via vault-refile-append (md, txt, html) or vault-ingest-pdf
provenance frontmatter attests to ORIGINAL file (path + sha256 of original bytes, not converted markdown)
unsupported extensions move to ops/inbox/_failed/<name> with <name>.reason sidecar; drain exits 1 on any failure
successful items move to ops/inbox/_ingested/<sha8>-<name>
SHA-idempotent: re-dropping identical bytes produces no new raw/ entry
ops/out/ sources remain refused by vault-refile-append (self-fueling loop prevention)
cycle logs append to ops/inbox/drain.log with INGEST/FAIL/SKIP/CYCLE rows
--compile triggers bin/vault-compile-replay only when at least one item was processed
tests/test_inbox_drain.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #15
designed for cron invocation (Hermes cron / launchd); no interactive deps

features.name: hermes-session-ingest-option-d
verification: bin/vault-ingest-hermes-session <session-file> <vault-root> exists, executable
accepts both .json (messages[] schema) and .jsonl session formats from ~/.hermes/sessions/
emits exactly one markdown file into <vault>/ops/inbox/ (never writes to raw/, notes/, or out/)
destination filename is deterministic: session-<stem>-<ext>.md, collision-safe for json/jsonl siblings
captures RAW transcript (role + content text preserved, no lossy summarization); per-message content cap 8192 chars
no wall-clock fields in body — sha-idempotent across re-runs so the drain refile de-dupes
after drain, inbox drop flows through refile to ops/raw/ with canonical provenance frontmatter (original_sha256 of inbox bytes, refiled_from set)
re-ingest + re-drain of identical session produces zero additional raw/ entries
tests/test_hermes_session_ingest.sh exits 0; wired as verify.sh gate #16
designed for Hermes cron invocation against ~/.hermes/sessions/ alongside inbox-drain
